workflow: A search-like operation saves a raw pointer into a mutable byte buffer before converting another argument.
The argument conversion re-enters the operation and clears or resizes the same buffer, releasing or relocating its storage.
The operation resumes with the saved pointer and continues reading from the invalidated storage.
The stale read causes a use-after-free and can terminate the process instead of raising a recoverable mutation error.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates a retained buffer pointer
